task: Fix Nearby Drivers component in TruckConnect
description: The Nearby Drivers component on the dashboard shows 'No drivers within 50 km' even when multiple accounts are active within a few meters. Fix the logic and real-time updates so that nearby drivers are detected correctly on mobile and desktop.

problems_identified.title: Drivers on the same device may be filtered out
problems_identified.details: Currently, the component may ignore drivers whose userId matches the current user or if the same device has multiple accounts.

problems_identified.title: Distance calculation may fail
problems_identified.details: Haversine formula or distance function may be incorrectly implemented, or lat/lon may be strings causing NaN distances.

problems_identified.title: Real-time updates not received
problems_identified.details: Nearby drivers may not appear because presence updates or location broadcasts are not correctly merged or subscribed to. The component may only subscribe to initial connections and ignore subsequent updates.

problems_identified.title: Mobile geolocation issues
problems_identified.details: Ensure mobile devices correctly broadcast current geolocation over secure context (HTTPS/ngrok).

expected_behavior: Drivers within the configured radius (50 km) are detected and displayed immediately
Drivers on the same network or different devices appear correctly
Distance calculation returns accurate values in km
Real-time updates merge new positions without overwriting existing drivers

tasks.description: Update the distance function to correctly compute Haversine distance in km
requirements: Convert all lat/lon values to numbers
Filter drivers by distance <= nearby radius
Do not ignore multiple accounts on the same device if they have different userIds
Ensure currentUserId filtering does not block detection of other accounts
Subscribe to Ably presence and update events
Merge incoming location updates into existing drivers array without overwriting
Emit nearby_driver_update correctly after every location broadcast (20s interval)
Test on mobile devices via HTTPS / ngrok
Prompt user for permission properly using navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition
Update store after first fix and every subsequent broadcast
Log distances to all nearby drivers
Log when a driver is filtered out or added

steps: Place two accounts 100 meters apart on separate devices
Verify both accounts appear in Nearby Drivers component
Check that updates occur every 20 seconds
Test on mobile via HTTPS / ngrok
